messages:
Maria Chen: quick heads-up — Vanguard on-prem cutover (Zeppelin tenant) hit NetSec egress gating. They require explicit outbound CIDRs for our monitoring endpoints before they lift the freeze. timeline: customer freeze Wed 03/11. can we async triage owners + blockers? :eyes:

Ajay Patel: I can own the NAT mapping + firewall rule change. need the exact customer CIDRs (they said they'd paste them today). any constraints re: proxy or dedicated nat?

Kevin O'Neill: i'll take cert rotation + vault grants. @Maria do we need to pin a customer CA on the nodes or use our intermediate CA? also confirm whether HSM-backed keys are required.

Nina Gomez: infra note — image signing is failing in airgapped stage: artifact-sync job returning 403 during key validation. ops-runner posted logs to the job.

ops-runner: artifact-sync job failed: 403 Forbidden - signature mismatch. log excerpt: ```
POST /sync/artifacts/zeppelind/2026-03-09  HTTP/1.1
Host: s3.internal
Authorization: SigV4 ...
=> 403 SignatureDoesNotMatch
```

Maria Chen: thanks. @Ajay customer said they'd paste CIDR in a DM (not public), asked for a short runbook for approvals. i'll request they copy the CIDR here so netsec can review.

Ajay Patel: i'll draft the runbook. who can run NAT e2e smoke on staging tomorrow AM? want to validate both proxy and direct nat paths.

Kevin O'Neill: i can do the staging smoke at 09:30 PST. quick check commands i'll run: ```nc -vz 10.2.3.4 443 && curl -sSf https://telemetry.redwood-internal/health``` please ensure staging token in `/etc/staging/token` is current.

Nina Gomez: NetSec requirement: disallow 0.0.0.0/0 egress fallback, add explicit fallback to internal proxy in same AZ. that's a terraform change in module `vpc-egress`. i will open a PR with plan output.

Maria Chen: @Nina please open PR against `infrastructure/vpc-egress`, include `plan` output and set reviewers to @Ajay and @kevin. mark CR as `urgent` and link this thread. also tag security.

Ajay Patel: noted. also, dedicated-capacity/product asks: if we can't get egress open in time, customer will accept fallback to hosted inference for a short window but requires data-plane isolation. ops, what's the billing/ops impact?

Kevin O'Neill: billing impact for a brief canary is minimal. routing to hosted still preserves TLS; we need KMS grants to avoid double-encrypt confusion. i'll confirm exact cost delta after smoke.

Nina Gomez: PR created: https://git.redwood/infrastructure/pulls/432 — includes terraform diff and `plan` snapshot. notes: requires KMS grant from customer for cross-account decrypt; HSM optional. tagged `sec-bot` and `ops-runner`.

sec-bot: SEC-992 opened: "Vanguard - external KMS principal and audit requirements". assigned to SecurityOps. recommended: require customer to provide IAM principal + logging policy.

Maria Chen: OK next steps: @Ajay draft runbook + NAT mapping today; @Kevin staging smoke 09:30 PST tomorrow; @Nina follow PR and link SEC-992; i'll coordinate with customer for CIDR + KMS principal. ping here if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
